🇲🇱 Mali has reported coordinated rebel attacks across five locations, including northern and central regions, as armed groups intensify pressure on the military government. 

According to the army, the attacks targeted Aguelhok, Anefis, Gao, Sevare, and Kenieroba — including areas where government forces and allied Russian personnel are deployed. 

The Malian military says at least 26 attackers were killed across different locations, while also reporting casualties among pro-government forces. Officials claim the situation is now under control. 

A Tuareg-led armed group confirmed responsibility for at least one of the attacks, highlighting ongoing conflict in northern Mali, where separatist and jihadist insurgencies have persisted for years. 

The latest escalation underscores the continued instability in the Sahel region despite repeated military campaigns to restore security. 

Source: Al Jazeera / AFP / Reuters
